<includeonly><div class="mw-collapsible {{#if:{{{2|{{{hide|}}}}}}|mw-collapsed|}}" data-expandtext="Show{{#if:{{{1|{{{text|}}}}}}|&#32;{{{1|{{{text}}}}}}|}}" data-collapsetext="Hide{{#if:{{{1|{{{text|}}}}}}|&#32;{{{1|{{{text}}}}}}|}}">{{#if: {{{1|{{{text|}}}}}}|'''{{ucfirst:{{{1|{{{text}}}}}}}}'''|}}</includeonly><noinclude>
==Description==
:This template is used for a collapsible section including section title.
;Syntax
:Insert this template using <code>{{tl|Collapsible_begin}}</code>, positioned immediately before the collapsible content.
:Works in conjunction with <code>{{tl|Collapsible_end}}</code>, positioned immediately after the collapsible content.
;Params
*{{Para|text}} To add a section title and additional text in the Show/Hide link.
*{{Para|hide}} The default state is not-collapsed, if instead you want the section hidden on page load, then use <code>hide=1</code>.

==Examples==
;Notes
:The default state of the collaspible content is not-collapsed, requiring user input to hide the collapsible content on each page visit or refresh.

;Example 1 - with title
:<code><nowiki>{{Collapsible_begin|members}}</nowiki></code>
:<code><nowiki>{|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}}
!Callsign!!Name!!Vehicle
|-
|Red Five||Luke Skywalker||X-wing
|}</nowiki></code>
:<code><nowiki>{{Collapsible_end}}</nowiki></code>

;Example 1 result
{{Collapsible_begin|members}}
{|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}}
!Callsign!!Name!!Vehicle
|-
|Red Five||Luke Skywalker||X-wing
|}
{{Collapsible_end}}

;Example 2 - without title
:<code><nowiki>{{Collapsible_begin}}</nowiki></code>
:<code><nowiki>{|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}}
!Callsign!!Name!!Vehicle
|-
|Red Five||Luke Skywalker||X-wing
|}</nowiki></code>
:<code><nowiki>{{Collapsible_end}}</nowiki></code>

;Example 2 result
{{Collapsible_begin}}
{|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}}
!Callsign!!Name!!Vehicle
|-
|Red Five||Luke Skywalker||X-wing
|}
{{Collapsible_end}}

;Example 3 - using '''hide=1'''
:<code><nowiki>{{Collapsible_begin||hide=1}}</nowiki></code>
:<code><nowiki>{|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}}
!Callsign!!Name!!Vehicle
|-
|Red Five||Luke Skywalker||X-wing
|}</nowiki></code>
:<code><nowiki>{{Collapsible_end}}</nowiki></code>

;Example 3 result
{{Collapsible_begin||hide=1}}
{|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}}
!Callsign!!Name!!Vehicle
|-
|Red Five||Luke Skywalker||X-wing
|}
{{Collapsible_end}}
